name: gizza-ai/text-encrypt
summary: Encrypt or decrypt text with a passphrase.

tool.description: Encrypt or decrypt text with a passphrase using AES-256-GCM (key derived via PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256). mode=encrypt (default) turns text into a compact base64 token (a fresh random salt + nonce each time); mode=decrypt turns a token produced by this tool back into the original text. The same passphrase is required to decrypt; a wrong passphrase or tampered token fails cleanly. Runs locally — the text and passphrase never leave the device.

text.description: The text to encrypt, or the base64 token to decrypt.

passphrase.description: The passphrase. The same passphrase is required to decrypt.

mode.description: encrypt (default) turns text into a base64 token; decrypt turns a token back into text.
